label: Lasers enter manufacturing
detail: TWI dates industrial laser use to the 1960s.

label: GE starts the printed LEAP fuel nozzle
detail: Development of the laser powder bed fuel nozzle begins.

label: ASML agrees to buy Cymer
detail: About EUR 1.95 billion for the excimer and EUV source maker (reported).

label: Fiber outsells CO2 for cutting
detail: First year fiber cutting lasers outsold CO2 (reported).

label: TRUMPF describes its EUV drive laser
detail: Five amplifier stages, mean pulse power above 30 kW.

label: xTool D1 launches
detail: The desktop engraver that started xTool (reported).

label: UK recall of Vevor laser engravers
detail: Plug pins below the 6.22 mm minimum; shock risk rated serious.

label: UK rejects Creality Falcon2 at the border
detail: 22 W Class 4 engraver found excessively strong for consumer use; goggles inadequate.

label: FDA withdraws Laser Notice No. 50
detail: Makers move to Laser Notice No. 56.

Glowforge restarts under its co-founders
detail: After an Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors.

label: xTool HKEX listing application made public
